self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Bane of Fire and Thunder (R5): Increases DMG against opponents affected by Pyro or Electro by 24%. A general DMG bonus (all_dmg_), not an elemental one. refinementStates carries R1/R3/R5 (R2/R4 read R1/R3); `states` stays the R5 tier.

en.flavor: A steel sword that is said to have been coated with dragon blood, rendering it invulnerable to damage. This effect is not extended to its wielder, however.

refinements.1: Increases DMG dealt against opponents affected by Pyro or Electro by <r>12%</r>.
refinements.2: Increases DMG dealt against opponents affected by Pyro or Electro by <r>15%</r>.
refinements.3: Increases DMG dealt against opponents affected by Pyro or Electro by <r>18%</r>.
refinements.4: Increases DMG dealt against opponents affected by Pyro or Electro by <r>21%</r>.
refinements.5: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Pyro or Electro by <r>24%</r>.

fr.flavor: Une épée en acier qui fut trempée dans du sang de dragon, la rendant invulnérable. On ne peut pas forcément en dire autant de la personne qui la manie.
